Updates `uvicorn` from 0.32.0 to 0.54.0
Release notes

Sourced from uvicorn's releases.

Version 0.54.0

📨 Send metadata after the response body

uvicorn 0.54.0 adds response trailers and 103 Early Hints to its experimental HTTP/2 implementation through zttp.

uv add uvicorn==0.54.0 "zttp>=0.0.34"
  • Send HTTP/2 response trailers (#3146). The ASGI http.response.trailers extension lets applications send metadata, such as checksums, after the response body. Clients must send TE: trailers to receive them. Multiple trailer messages are combined before completing the response.
  • HTTP/2 remains experimental and opt-in. Enable it with --http zttp --http2. Upgrade-based h2c and WebSockets over HTTP/2 remain unsupported.

💡 Hint at resources before the final response

  • Send 103 Early Hints over HTTP/2 (#3137). Applications can use the ASGI http.response.early_hint extension to send resource hints before the final response. Each supplied link becomes a separate Link header.

Full changelog: 0.53.0...0.54.0

Version 0.53.0

🌐 Opt-in HTTP/2 support

uvicorn 0.53.0 adds experimental HTTP/2 through zttp, alongside a new zuvloop integration and connection-handling improvements.

uv add uvicorn==0.53.0
  • Serve HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 with zttp (#2982, #3101). Install zttp, then enable HTTP/2 with --http zttp --http2. Uvicorn negotiates HTTP/2 over TLS with ALPN and supports cleartext prior knowledge.
  • HTTP/2 remains experimental. Upgrade-based h2c and WebSockets over HTTP/2 are not supported.

⚙️ More event loop choice

  • Run Uvicorn with zuvloop (#3104). Install zuvloop separately and select it explicitly with --loop zuvloop on CPython 3.14 or newer.

🛡️ More reliable connections and proxies

  • Honor Connection: close token lists (#3103). Uvicorn now parses comma-separated tokens case-insensitively across HTTP implementations.
  • Trust IPv6 loopback proxies by default (#3119). The default FORWARDED_ALLOW_IPS value now includes ::1.
  • Keep upgraded WebSockets alive (#3107). Uvicorn cancels the HTTP keep-alive timer when the connection becomes a WebSocket.

Full changelog: 0.52.4...0.53.0

Version 0.52.4

Fixed

  • Remove duplicate Date headers from accepted WebSocket handshakes with websockets-sansio (#3078)

Updates `pydantic-settings` from 2.6.0 to 2.16.3
Release notes

Sourced from pydantic-settings's releases.

v2.16.3

Highlights

This patch release fixes a security issue in the default secrets source, a regression from 2.14.2 that dropped nested secrets on Kubernetes, and a CliApp.serialize round-trip bug with CliUnknownArgs.

Security

  • SecretsSettingsSource no longer follows symlinks that resolve outside secrets_dir (#1138, fixes #1137). A secret file that is a symbolic link to a file outside secrets_dir was read into the matching field, so anyone who could place a link in secrets_dir could make the application load any file it can read. This is the plain-source counterpart of GHSA-4xgf-cpjx-pc3j, whose fix in 2.14.2 covered only NestedSecretsSettingsSource. Links that stay inside secrets_dir, such as the Kubernetes secret volume layout (passwd linking to ..data/passwd), still work.

Behavior changes

  • A secret file that resolves outside secrets_dir is now skipped with a warning instead of being read (#1138). If you deliberately point secret files at targets elsewhere on disk, move or copy the targets into secrets_dir, or point secrets_dir at the directory that holds them.
  • NestedSecretsSettingsSource skips hidden entries (names starting with .) again, as it did before 2.14.2, and stops with a SettingsError after 10,000 entries (#1070).

Bug fixes

Secrets

  • With secrets_nested_subdir=True, a directory reached through a second symlink is loaded again (#1070, fixes #1061). Since 2.14.2, only the name that sorted first was walked, so the standard Kubernetes secret volume layout (db linking to ..data/db) silently lost its nested secrets.
  • A symlink loop inside secrets_dir is skipped instead of aborting the load with RuntimeError on Python 3.11 and 3.12 (#1070, #1138).

CLI

  • CliApp.serialize keeps each level's CliUnknownArgs before that level's subcommand token (#1050, fixes #1048). They were emitted after the last subcommand, so parsing the output again moved a parent's unknown args onto the subcommand.

What's Changed

  • Fix CliApp.serialize moving a parent unknown args into the subcommand by @​XXXXXQ-0206 in pydantic/pydantic-settings#1050
  • Load nested secrets reached through a second directory link by @​digit50 in pydantic/pydantic-settings#1070
  • Prevent SecretsSettingsSource from following symlinks outside secrets_dir by @​twotnguyen in pydantic/pydantic-settings#1138

New Contributors

  • @​XXXXXQ-0206 made their first contribution in pydantic/pydantic-settings#1050
  • @​twotnguyen made their first contribution in pydantic/pydantic-settings#1138

Full Changelog: https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-settings/compare/v2.16.2...v2.16.3

v2.16.2

Highlights

This patch release fixes env decoding of nested dictionary values, CliApp handling of AliasPath, nested secrets directory precedence and discriminated union defaults with nested_model_default_partial_update.

Behavior changes

  • An explicit secrets_dir on NestedSecretsSettingsSource now takes precedence (#1093). Previously it was ignored when the wrapped SecretsSettingsSource inherited a directory from model config, and an explicit empty list was masked too. The order is now: the wrapper's secrets_dir argument, then the wrapped source's directory, then model config. If you pass both Settings(_secrets_dir=...) and NestedSecretsSettingsSource(..., secrets_dir=...), the wrapper's argument now wins.

Updates `python-multipart` from 0.0.17 to 0.0.34
Release notes

Sourced from python-multipart's releases.

Version 0.0.34

⚡ Faster form parsing

This release reduces parser overhead for forms with many fields and corrects multipart boundary and header handling. Parsers created without callbacks also no longer share callback registrations.

pip install python-multipart==0.0.34
  • Faster query-string parsing (#372). The parser reuses separator positions and starts the next field directly when its data is already available.
  • Less overhead for multipart forms (#370, #373). Complete CRLF sequences are consumed without stepping through each intermediate parser state, and mark-helper functions are no longer created on each write.

🧩 More predictable multipart handling

  • Padded boundaries no longer merge adjacent parts (#363). Spaces and tabs after delimiters between parts are recognized as transport padding. Malformed padding now raises MultipartParseError instead of being returned as part data. Padded opening boundaries remain unsupported.
  • Non-ASCII parameter bytes are preserved (#364). parse_options_header trims only spaces and tabs, rather than all Unicode whitespace. This avoids changing parameter values such as names ending in the UTF-8 bytes for à.
  • Whitespace around part header values is ignored by FormParser (#366). For example, Content-Transfer-Encoding: base64 is recognized and decoded despite the trailing space. Low-level MultipartParser callbacks still receive the raw header value bytes.

🛡️ Isolated callbacks and clearer security scope

  • Callback registrations stay with their parser (#362). Parsers constructed without callbacks now get separate dictionaries, so calling set_callback() on one no longer changes another parser's handlers.
  • A documented threat model (#358, #359, #367). The threat model defines trust boundaries, application responsibilities, and vulnerability scope. Bugs in deprecated Content-Transfer-Encoding decoding are handled as public bug reports rather than security reports.

💜 Thank you

Thanks to @​deadstrobe5 and @​g4lb for the parser performance proposals that informed this release.

Full changelog: 0.0.33...0.0.34

Version 0.0.33

🛡️ Safer form parsing

This release lets you cap URL-encoded form fields as they stream in, and fixes several upload and decoding edge cases. It also drops Python 3.10 and adds Python 3.15.

pip install python-multipart==0.0.33
  • Limit URL-encoded fields while streaming (#333). The new opt-in MAX_FIELDS and MAX_FIELD_SIZE options for FormParser raise FormParserError before oversized data is buffered. Both default to no limit, and multipart forms are unaffected.
  • Nameless uploads no longer crash when spilled to disk (#343). Uploads without a filename used to raise AttributeError when UPLOAD_KEEP_EXTENSIONS or UPLOAD_KEEP_FILENAME was set.
  • UPLOAD_DIR accepts str with UPLOAD_KEEP_FILENAME (#335). A str upload directory used to fail on the first write to disk.
  • Decoded data is complete before callbacks run (#336, #355). Content-Transfer-Encoding decoders are finalized at the end of each part, and quoted-printable escapes split across writes decode correctly.
  • parse_options_header lowercases content types with parameters (#287). Multipart/Form-Data; boundary=abc now returns multipart/form-data, the same as headers without parameters.

⚡ Faster parsing

  • Faster opening boundary matching (#328). Complete boundaries are matched in one step.
  • Faster parser state lookups (#330). Parser states are module-level enum members, so their repr is now multipart.END instead of <MultipartState.END: 12>.
  • Faster querystring callback dispatch (#316).
